DEFINITION: the liver as the locus of feelings and dispositions
NOTE: Hmong locates feelings in the liver (siab), not the heart. Close to i67941 'heart, bosom: the locus of feelings and intuitions', but siab does not pattern in the same idioms, so it is not the same concept. The meaning is from Nathan White (2026-10); the organ is i65277 'liver'
